quotes.text: We don't live in this perfect orthogonal world of graph paper. Things out here are messy. When you live in a software world, it's easy to think everything can be reduced to rules.
The source of truth for most of construction is unstructured plans and specs. Thousands of pages. Stuff slips through the cracks until the last responsible moment when it blows up in your face.
There's never been a better time to be a high agency person. The tools at our disposal now are insane. But the fundamentals are still really important, which is product sense.
